# temporal precision

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/temporalPrecision>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The granularity to which an event's time is known — a [`gmeow:TemporalPrecision`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalPrecision.md) value (day / month / year / decade / circa). Makes the determinacy of a date explicit instead of pretending every date is to-the-day.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:TemporalPrecision`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalPrecision.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`gmeow:TemporalPrecision`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalPrecision.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md), [`gmeow:TemporalPrecision`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalPrecision.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare HOW PRECISELY an event's time is known — to the day, month, year, decade, or circa — making date determinacy explicit rather than pretending every date is to-the-day.

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating it as the date itself (the bounds are [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md) / [`gmeow:latestEnd`](gmeow-latestEnd.md)) or as epistemic [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md); precision is the ontic granularity of the dating, an orthogonal facet ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) at one [`gmeow:TemporalPrecision`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalPrecision.md) value alongside its date bounds; consumers read it to render 'c. 1850' rather than a spurious to-the-second figure.

- ex:battle [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) [`gmeow:precisionCirca`](../individuals/gmeow-precisionCirca.md).
